about_the_game:
Kill Humans, Enter the Zombie Era!

About the Game

"Necro Genesis" is an action-packed, dark-humor game where you control a cute zombie girl and mercilessly slaughter humans!

Throw your ethics out the window and enjoy this twisted world.

Features

  • A low-budget, 2D top-down action game with simple controls that are easy to pick up and play.

  • Wave-based arena combat format.

  • While there are very few Roguelite elements, you can strengthen your cards (equipment) to gain an advantage over your previous run.

  • Single-player only. There are absolutely no multiplayer elements, so you never have to worry about getting flamed by other players.

  • One-time purchase game. New stages and new zombie types will be released through free updates.

  • Zero in-game purchases or monetization.

  • Data is saved locally, not on a server. Please be careful not to lose your save data.

Controls (Default Settings)

  • Confirm, Normal Attack : Enter | Right Button (○)

  • Back, Pause : Backspace | Bottom Button (×)

  • Move Up : W | D-Pad Up (▲)

  • Move Down : S | D-Pad Down (▼)

  • Move Left : A | D-Pad Left (◀)

  • Move Right : D | D-Pad Right (▶)

  • Sexy Necro Shot : Q | Top Button (△)

content_descriptors.notes: While not graphically detailed, the game frequently includes depictions of humans being sliced with swords and other weapons. Additionally, the game contains Japanese dialogue with sexual, violent, and extremely offensive language.
